title: bug: approving an already-approved rail proposal appends its rail again, and rejecting an approved one leaves its rail live
description:
Observed on 2026-10-30.
- 12:56:23Z: the human approved four proposals in the IDE (prop-96635005, prop-da2a6c91, prop-4fe44aac, prop-10384054).
- 13:00:41Z: a governor script sent APPROVE_PROPOSAL over /ws for three of them and REJECT_PROPOSAL for prop-4fe44aac.
- Result: each re-approved ADD_RAIL was appended a second time, so epic CQ-R carried the CQ-R11e2 rail twice, CQ-RF the RF04 rail three times and the WT epic the WT-S rail twice.
- prop-4fe44aac flipped to REJECTED while its rail stayed in epicRails.
- Cleanup took four REMOVE_RAIL proposals (prop-0d2ff5ad, d4edfe4d, 252a4d2d, fab7280e).

Cause: packages/moe-daemon/src/state/StateManager.ts.
- approveProposal (~L1369) calls applyRailChange and then sets APPROVED, whatever the current status is.
- rejectProposal (~L1466) sets REJECTED on an APPROVED proposal without reverting it.
- Any two clients can trigger this: two IDE windows, a double-click, or a script.

Fix:
- approveProposal and rejectProposal act only on a PENDING proposal.
- A repeat of the same decision on an already-resolved proposal is an idempotent no-op that returns the stored proposal.
- The opposite decision on a resolved proposal is refused with a fixed error, sent back over /ws as an ERROR message.
- Rails, the proposal file and the activity log stay unchanged in both cases.

Out of scope: the IDE UI and the cleanup already done.
definitionOfDone: A second approveProposal on an APPROVED ADD_RAIL proposal leaves epicRails, global rails and task rails unchanged (no duplicate), returns the stored proposal and appends no PROPOSAL_APPROVED event. Shown by a daemon test.

rejectProposal on an APPROVED proposal, and approveProposal on a REJECTED one, are refused with a fixed error. The record, the rails and the activity log are unchanged, and the /ws handler replies with ERROR. Shown by tests.
A PENDING proposal is still approved and rejected exactly as before, shown by the existing proposal tests, and `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits 0.
